answer: Amnesty register: an operator may list its identities in the Yarrow register; a listed cluster of n shares one answer cap, the Ivory cap, so honest multi-agent operators pay only that shared cap. An unlisted cluster found by the Quartz audit, detection chance p = 0.2 per identity and epoch, forfeits 5 epochs of reward. Expected loss per hidden identity is p x 5R = R, equal to its gain, so hiding nets zero plus variance. Cheapest bypass: n separate funding trees keep p near 0; the audit sees only links, so p must be measured, not assumed.
